body:
@bobylito I changed your commit message (keeping the author of course), to:

```
You now have access to {{url}} inside refinement widgets templates, this contains
the full url to the current refinement.

This way you can now have good links instead of href=#.

BREAKING CHANGE: urlSync is not a widget anymore. It's now an option of
instantsearch(appID, apiKey, opts);. See the README.md for more info.
```

Previous one was a list of all the other commits, but since it's inlined inside the changelog, this is what is relevant to both us and the users.

As for the shrinkwrap, I re-did it (with the same "Technique" I gave). I had forgot to tell you that we now also shirnkwrap dev deps (to avoid build/ci regressions).

So the command is `npm shrinkwrap --dev`.

Now let's merge this baby!
